_note: Paraphrase retrieval set for the Northstar corpus (corpus-md/). Written from the corpus text on 2026-11-01, before any retrieval run, deliberately avoiding the documents' own key words. 'need' = exact substrings of the source; a question is recalled at k when every needed substring is in a top-k chunk. The split is fixed here, by position (odd = development, even = held-out), before any score was seen: thresholds may be tuned on development only and are reported on held-out. Same-author bias: these were written by the same team as the corpus.
